glosses: to concentrate one's energy (strength, attention, etc.) on
to flow into (e.g. of a river)

exampleTranslations.1: I poured the wine in a plastic bag and then dipped it in ice water.
exampleTranslations.4: He concentrated his energies on helping his friend.
exampleTranslations.5: The river descends from the mountains to the bay below.
exampleTranslations.6: The room was bathed in sunshine.
